incidents.title: Mother believes fake kidnappers cloned her daughter's voice
incidents.outcome: A ransom was demanded; the mother confirmed her daughter was safe before paying.
incidents.confidenceReason: The voice clone is the mother's belief; CNN reports law enforcement has not verified that AI was used.
incidents.summary: An Arizona mother received a call in which a voice she believes was cloned from her 15-year-old daughter's pleaded for help while a man demanded a ransom.
incidents.quote: Law enforcement has not verified whether AI was used in her case, but DeStefano believes scammers cloned her daughter’s voice.
incidents.singleSourceReason: Only CNN has reported this operation among the sources found in the 2026-11-17 sweep.

sources.title: Mother believes fake kidnappers cloned her daughter's voice
